title: Ferry and Water Transit — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Ferries move commuters across harbors and rivers where bridges are congested or absent. Waterfront terminals double as public spaces when designed well. This overview edition presents Ferry and Water Transit as a core transit concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Design for frequency, speed, and reliability
Integrate fares and transfers across modes

real_examples.fact: New York's NYC Ferry and Hong Kong's Star Ferry carry daily commuters.

spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
